_comment: Golden O/X/Draw counts for 10000 games. Every implementation is
deterministic: fixed seed, fixed shuffle, 64-bit integer arithmetic only,
so these values are identical on x86_64 and aarch64.
The counts differ between languages because the seeds differ. ttt.c,
ttt.cc, ttt-mt.cc, ttt.go, ttt.ml and ttt.lean all seed the shared
xorshift with 1729163 and must agree exactly - that is identical_group.
ttt.rs seeds 1729, ttt.js seeds 172916342314, and ttt.py / ttt.java use
their standard library generators, so each stands alone.
ttt-alt.c is a different game entirely: 40x40 board, win condition 12.
Values that were predicted rather than measured, and are confirmed by
the first CI run. Remove a name from this list once CI has agreed.
